case-262.en:
Generate video: a cinematic 10-second music video, shot in a dark modern dance studio with a smooth gray reflective floor, black walls, and horizontal neon tubes. Continuous dynamic camera movement, mainly medium shots and close-ups, never pulling too wide. The female lead is always moving, no frozen or static poses.

Main character: 20-year-old young East Asian woman, messy medium-long wavy black hair, bangs partially covering her face, cool pale skin, black eyes, full glossy lips. She wears a white silk slip dress. She sings throughout, lip-sync clear and precise, mouth actively moving, strong emotional expression.

Lyrics: "ねえ、君は名前の入った箱をしまっているんだね / ベッド脇の引き出しの中に / ポラロイド写真やチケットの半券を / 赤いものの下に詰め込んで / 君はただ一つだけを持っていくんじゃなくて / 最後の残り火のすべてをさらっていく / そして、それぞれの秘められた心に / 小さな指の跡を残していくんだ" (Hey, you're keeping a box with a name on it / in the drawer beside the bed / Polaroid photos and ticket stubs / stuffed under the red things / You're not just taking one thing with you / you're sweeping away all the last embers / And on each hidden heart / you leave a small fingerprint).

0-2s: tight medium close-up. She leans her upper body back, head tilted to the side, singing passionately, strong lip-sync, hair falling onto her face, body arched, one hand sliding across her chest.

2-4s: camera slowly pushes in and orbits. She recovers from a deep arched pose, torso still bent forward, hands on thighs, raises her head and looks directly into the camera while singing with aggressive lip-sync. Three male dancers with different appearances (different ethnicities, hairstyles, and body types), wearing black tank tops and black loose pants, have already moved close around her, moving with her in low-tension poses. Two other male dancers are visible at the edge of the frame, approaching.

4-6s: medium close-up. She crouches low, body still continuously moving, hair swinging, singing intensely, mouth movements clear, head turning sharply, eyes locked on the camera. The male dancers stay close, their hands lightly touching her as they move together.

6-8s: medium shot, with slow camera drift. Exactly five male dancers with completely different appearances, all wearing black tank tops and black loose pants, tightly surround her on the floor in a dense interwoven formation. She is at the center, body still moving, upper body rising and shifting, singing with intense lip-sync. All five male dancers move subtly with her, never static. The male dancers never completely block her body.

8-10s: dynamic medium shot. The five diverse male dancers lift her into the air into a powerful deep backbend pose. Her body is fully extended and arched, head thrown back, still singing with clear lip-sync. They hold her, gently rocking up and down with the beat. The camera starts from a clear side view of her arched body and smoothly transitions to a frontal view of her face. At the end, they smoothly lower her onto her feet; immediately after landing she continues singing, and the five male dancers remain in low poses around her. The male dancers never completely block her.

High-fashion dance energy, sweaty skin, sharp timing, continuous fluid movement of the female lead, accurate lip-sync prioritized in every frame.

Rules: no hand deformation, no body distortion, clean and stable anatomy, fingers and hands consistent and natural throughout the video., 16:9

小女孩闭着眼睛开心地大笑，而父亲充满爱意地看着她。他紧紧拥抱她，并轻轻原地旋转。以一幅美丽的广角镜头结束：父亲在发光的窗前抱着他大笑的女儿，温暖的阳光透过窗帘流泻进来，柔和的镜头光晕，宁静的家庭氛围。

镜头：以窗帘后幼儿的特写开始，缓慢推近，切到父亲注意到她的中景，用平滑跟拍镜头跟随他的动作，用富有表现力的特写呈现他的面部反应，然后在他抱起她时过渡为轻柔的手持风格推镜，最后以广角电影感镜头结束。
